attention_budget.derivation: Voice, readable quote and melodic lead compete for attention; a fixed duck amount cannot decide the hierarchy.
attention_budget.method: Map the intended focus by phrase and action beat. Audition a coherent musical phrase with speech spacing, word audibility and music continuity together, using the selected track rather than isolated voice.
attention_budget.early_proof: Same short integrated mix through all three beats at normal and phone listening level; Director judges direct audio.
attention_budget.failure_condition: Key words disappear, score seems switched off, or reading the quote sacrifices the action.
attention_budget.reopen_when: Camera, source authority, performance, contacts or coupled assets change; previous evidence no longer covers the shot.

word_proof.derivation: The important claim relies on races and impeccable being understandable, not merely on average voice loudness.
word_proof.method: Check those phrase endings separately from overall loudness; use automation and spectral room before indiscriminate global ducking.
word_proof.early_proof: First-listen transcription check at ordinary volume plus waveform/peak checks; latter alone cannot PASS intelligibility.
word_proof.failure_condition: A listener cannot repeat the central words or must strain while music seems fine.
word_proof.reopen_when: Camera, source authority, performance, contacts or coupled assets change; previous evidence no longer covers the shot.

impact_and_reuse.derivation: Punch and exact event placement must survive retiming without rerendering the scene.
impact_and_reuse.method: Keep contact-event anchors and separate stems; test attack plus low body in context and avoid clipped peaks.
impact_and_reuse.early_proof: Aligned opening/turn impacts with reusable edit decision and stem offsets.
impact_and_reuse.failure_condition: Impact lacks weight, slips from contact or masks speech.
impact_and_reuse.reopen_when: Camera, source authority, performance, contacts or coupled assets change; previous evidence no longer covers the shot.

challenge.cross_discipline_conflicts: Intelligibility and uninterrupted musical force can conflict. Surface script-density or voice-character tradeoffs to the Director if mix remedies cannot satisfy both. Do not silently remove the quote narration or claim the later chosen ramp was inevitable.
